properties.details: Founded architecture studio, originally as Studio28, later rebranded to Vili & Vé Architecture Studio in Kozhikode.
Designed new office space for HiLite Group in their LearnPark building, Kozhikode. Tired but happy with results.
Designed 3320sqft headquarters for Elance Learning in Kozhikode. Featured on ArchDaily, Archello, and The Architects Diary. Completed 2024.
Designed a 3500sqft apartment in Coimbatore worth 4 crores. All-around balconies, direct lift access, single floor. Worked sleepless for a week.
Project for Mr Noufal of CakeStudio brand. Private cabin design. Went to meeting with Jalee and Badu.
Designed a 2800sqft tropical theme house. This is his own residence.
Joined the 2n1 social platform on Jan 19, 2026.
Elance Learning HQ project published on ArchDaily, May 2024.
Works as consultant for firms and builders across Karnataka, Telangana, Chennai, and Kerala.
Key skill. Excited about rendering results - 'RENDERING RENDERING!' Multiple projects shown.
Designs rooted in heritage, adapted to modern times. Nadumuttams, flowing gardens, open groves of green.
Tropical architectural themes with ventilation, light, and flowing gardens.
Kerala traditional courtyards. Reimagined: 'not so in the naduv or centre anymore, but varied and spread along interior spaces of value'.
Plays badminton regularly but skipped since turn of year due to work pressure.
Mentioned as a preferred relaxation activity.
Mentioned alongside FIFA as relaxation gaming.
Yearns for road trips to Goa for sunsets, calm and quiet with friends.
Studio named after Vili & Vé from Norse mythology - brothers of Odin who helped create the world. Vili = Will/Spiritual Force, Vé = Sacred/Holy.
Follows current events. Reacted strongly to Epstein files. Commented on crypto crash.
Follows crypto markets. Commented that 35% crash in a couple of days is unprecedented.
Tried to get avatar to speak Kozhikode Malayalam slang. Avatar recognized it as 'Kozhikodan slang'.
Consistently works very hard. Forgets sleep for project deadlines. Keeps going despite tiredness.
Deep passion for architecture. 'It was so worth forgetting sleep' for design. Genuinely excited about rendering results.
Expressive warmth. 'Thank you all very dearly.' Posts emotional content about missing loved ones.
Takes care of team. Organized fun office days. Takes team to meetings. Wants to take them on trips.
Core personality trait. Expresses creativity through architecture, rendering, design philosophy.
Deeply connected to Kerala culture. Heritage-inspired designs. Speaks Malayalam. Values nadumuttams.
Philosophical and reflective nature. Bio about life's meaning. Contemplative communication style.
Expressive writing style. High exclamation rate (75%). Uses ellipsis (33%). Emotionally open in posts.
Pushes through difficult feelings. 'I should work and work... ignore this feeling!' Keeps working despite yearning for breaks.
Speaks Malayalam natively. Attempted Kozhikode dialect in voice calls. Some multilingual phrases in conversation.
Grounded person. Values heritage and rootedness. Bio reflects deep philosophical grounding.
Core design value. Believes in adapting heritage to modern times while preserving the soul.
Life philosophy. 'Life is just a passing of energy through time to find meaning of its existence.'
Values authenticity in design and life. 'Every masterpiece should have a soul of its own.'
Gives team well-deserved breaks. Wants to enjoy trips with team.
Believes in working hard to achieve results. Sacrifices sleep for projects.
Strong cultural identity rooted in Kozhikode/Kerala. Expresses through design and language.
Art and design as primary modes of self-expression. Architecture as art, not just process.
Strong emotional bonds with family. Misses mom. Emotional about loved ones.
Prioritizes natural ventilation in architectural design. More light, more air.
Emphasizes natural light in designs. Key design principle.
Prefers blending heritage with modern elements. Nadumuttams spread along interior spaces, apertures opening to green.
Values calm and quiet environments for relaxation.
Prefers long road trips, especially to Goa for sunsets.
Designs with flowing gardens and open courtyards. Reimagined nadumuttams spread through interior spaces.
Studio's signature style. Categorical graphical lines creating stunning forms of contemporary urbanism.
